Run tools/fabric-deploy-preflight.mjs and require every local .vercel/project.json to match state/FABRIC-DEPLOYMENT-MANIFEST.json.
Reconcile local staged app-shell changes with newer canonical GitHub source before deploying.
Deploy Kork, ShatteredCastle(s), GlassWitness, BlastRadial, Investigation Console, and the public hub/registry to their manifest-bound Vercel projects.
Re-run Fabric Conformance and require every job, including public-contract, to pass before clearing drift.
